clarified_messages.content: I'm at the server room, prepping the hardware for the deployment.
Perfect. Can you grab the config file from the rack on your left? It's labeled 'v3.21-alpha'.
Got it. I'll use the config file labeled 'v3.21-alpha' from the rack on my left.
Once you're ready, give me the signal and I'll reboot the proxy down here in the server room.
Ready on my end. You can reboot now.
Rebooting... All right, it's done. Are you seeing the new logs on your console?
Yes, I see the new logs flowing in. Looks like the update is getting applied.
Great. Did you set the credentials for the app server to use the new vault key, or is it still using the old one?
I'm switching the vault now. The file in this folder should have the new key. I'll confirm in a minute.
Let me know once you're sure. I don't want any access errors at go-live.
Key updated. It shows the new hash on my console.
Perfect. Did you ping Corey to confirm the workflow, or should I?
I haven't yet. If you could reach out, that'd be great.
Got it. I'll message Corey now.
Let me know what Corey says.
Corey replied—we should run the verification script after the backup finishes.
When did Corey say the backup is scheduled for?
Corey said the backup is scheduled right after 11:05 AM.
Ok, I'll queue the script for right after 11:05 AM.
Can you double-check the resource file in the folder you mentioned earlier? It was missing the last time I updated it.
Let me check… Yeah, the resource file is here now. Must've synced with the repo.
Awesome. For the secondary node, can you grab the cable near the window? I think it's the fiber we need.
I'll grab the cable near the window. Is it the short one or the long one?
The long cable with blue connectors.
Got it. Plugging in the long cable with blue connectors now.
Nice. Also, did you see the note from Serena about adjusting CPU allocation?
No, didn't see it yet. Was it from Serena?
Yeah. Serena says we should bump the main node by two cores before next cycle.
I'll apply those changes soon. Is there a deadline Serena mentioned?
Serena said 'before noon,' so we’ve got just over an hour.
Okay, will do. By the way, did you set the environment variable for the test suite, or should I?
I haven't yet. Go ahead and set 'ENV_TEST_STAGE' to 'true'.
Done. 'ENV_TEST_STAGE' is set to true now.
Perfect. Also, the package for the patch—did it arrive at your location or mine?
The package got dropped off at the front desk at my location. I'll bring it to the server room.
Awesome. Is the package the box with the orange sticker or the blue label?
The package is the box with the orange sticker. That matches the tracking number.
Great. Next, do you still have the login for the backup node, or should I ask IT?
I lost access to the backup node yesterday. Better check with IT.
Okay, I'll send a request to IT. Anything else you need me to ask for?
Could you ask for a password reset for the container registry, too?
Will do. By the way, did you see the patches in the document Serena sent last night?
Not yet, I'll open the document after this step.
Serena's note mentioned there's one critical security fix.
Thanks for the heads up. I'll apply the critical security fix as soon as I see it.
Also, should I clear the old logs now or wait until after the backup?
Hold off until the backup is verified. Just in case.
Good call. Anything else on your end?
Just need confirmation from Corey once the backup ends, then we can proceed.
I'll keep an eye out for Corey's message.
Great. This went smoother than last week. Remember that mess?
Ha, don't remind me. Today’s setup is much better. Weather's nicer, too.
Definitely. All right, I'm wrapping up here.
Talk soon. Ping me when you’re done.
